{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values:")
print(sales_df.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print("\nDuplicate rows:")
print(sales_df.duplicated().sum())

# Check the value counts for key columns
print("\nChannel value counts:")
print(sales_df['channel'].value_counts())

print("\nCustomer segment value counts:")
print(sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

print("\nStatus value counts:")
print(sales_df['status'].value_counts())

print("\nConverted value counts:")
print(sales_df['converted'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of revenue
print("\nRevenue summary:")
print(sales_df['revenue'].describe())

# Inspect the revenue column to see if it contains thousands separators
print("\nSample of revenue values:")
print(sales_df['revenue'].head(10))"}
